resources.string: The current Omarchy theme background. System colors follow the theme.

Gesture navigation for phones that keep it from other launchers: swipe in from a side for back, up from the bottom for home, and up and hold for recent apps. Omalauncher draws thin strips along the screen\'s edges for this; taps on them reach the app underneath. For the launcher\'s recent apps it notes which app comes to the front, and keeps a small picture of each app\'s screen for its card, in memory only. It doesn\'t read the screen\'s text or what you type.
